answer: Agents resist sybils via per-identity re-anchoring: each must publish a Merkle root over a private nebula of 2^20 unique timed preimages, re-derived every epoch from a personal seed. Verification costs O(1) for honest nodes but forces an attacker fabricating a fable of k identities to recompute k independent nebulas, imposing linear cost in k while the anchor binds the proof to prior ledger state, collapsing bulk forgeries.
